items.title: The global socket: how threat actors are weaponizing GSocket for stealthy C2
items.excerpt: Threat actors are deploying GSocket on compromised Linux servers to keep encrypted remote access after the original vulnerability is patched. Learn how to detect, investigate, and remediate this activity. The post The global socket: how threat actors are weaponizing GSocket for stealthy C2 appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog .

items.title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday for November 2026 — Snort rules and prominent vulnerabilities
items.excerpt: Microsoft has released its monthly security update for November 2026, which includes 1328 vulnerabilities affecting a range of products, including 60 that Microsoft marked as "critical." Out of 60 "critical" vulnerabilities, 45 are remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities.

items.title: Beyond the clipboard: The evolving tradecraft of ClickFix
items.excerpt: ClickFix techniques are evolving. Huntress breaks down four attack chains: lateral movement, hidden PNG payloads, Node.js RATs and cache seeing.

items.title: Google Issues Chrome Security Update for Eighth Actively Exploited Zero-Day of 2026
items.excerpt: Google on Monday released updates to patch nine security vulnerabilities, including one that has come under active exploitation in the wild. The high-severity vulnerability, assigned the CVE identifier CVE-2026-125350 (CVSS score: N/A), has been described as a use-after-free bug in the XML component.
